instance_name.label: Instance Name
instance_name.description: Name of this MA instance as it will appear in Yandex Smart Home. Alice will use this name for voice commands, e.g. "Алиса, включи музыку на [имя]".

label_connection_type_notice.label: 💡 After changing Connection Type below, click Save and reopen this settings page to see the fields for the new mode.

connection_type.label: Connection Type
connection_type.description: "cloud" — public Yaha Cloud skill (simple setup). "cloud_plus" — private skill via cloud relay (for multi-platform setups). "direct" — Yandex calls your MA server directly (requires public HTTPS URL).

label_cloud_conflict_warning.label: ⚠️ If this Yandex account already uses the Yaha Cloud skill via Home Assistant or another Music Assistant install, pick 'Cloud Plus' above instead — the public skill can only be linked to one instance per account.

otp_code.label: OTP Code
otp_code.description: Copy this code and enter it in the Yandex app.

register_cloud.label: Register cloud instance
register_cloud.description: Registers a new instance on yaha-cloud.ru relay.

get_otp.label: Get OTP code
get_otp.description: Get a fresh one-time password to link with Yandex.

exposed_players.label: Exposed Players
exposed_players.description: Select which MA players to expose to Yandex Smart Home. Leave empty to expose all players.

auto_create_skill.description: Runs the Yandex Device Flow login, then creates and publishes the private Smart Home skill.

manual_backend_url.label: Backend URL (→ Basic info)
manual_backend_url.description: Copy to 'Basic info' → 'Backend URL' in your skill.

manual_token_url.label: Token URL (→ Account linking, both fields)
manual_token_url.description: Paste into BOTH 'Token endpoint' and 'Refresh token URL'.

auto_create_user_code.label: Device code for ya.ru/device
auto_create_user_code.description: Open the URL below, log in to your Yandex account, and enter this code.

current_ma_base_url.label: Current MA Base URL (read-only)
current_ma_base_url.description: For reference. Change it in Settings → Core → Webserver → Base URL; provider doesn't own this setting.

oauth_url.label: OAuth URL (open to get token)
oauth_url.description: Open this URL in your browser, approve, and copy the access_token from the resulting URL into the field below.

skill_token.label: Skill OAuth Token
skill_token.description: Paste the OAuth token obtained from the URL above.

skill_id.label: Skill ID
skill_id.description: UUID of your private Smart Home skill. Set automatically when auto-create succeeds; you can paste it manually if you created the skill by hand.

skill_dialogs_link.label: Open skill in Yandex.Dialogs
skill_dialogs_link.description: Click the link to open the skill's page.

manual_client_secret.label: Client Secret value (for reference)
manual_client_secret.description: Copy this string into 'Account linking' → 'Client secret'.

manifest.description: Expose Music Assistant players to Yandex Alice via Yandex Smart Home API.
